purpose: Master frontend/UX preferences for future projects, not a fixed theme or app-specific design system.
hard_rules: Do not force a fixed color palette across projects.
Do not copy current-app content, labels, layouts, or features into unrelated future projects.
Use project-specific visual direction and semantic tokens.
Avoid container soup, chip soup, CTA soup, and form energy for fast actions.
Make clickable and non-clickable elements visually distinct.
Use progressive disclosure instead of exposing every option.
No modal chains unless explicitly required.
Always check contrast, responsive fit, and button hierarchy.
likes: single dominant focal object per screen
responsive layouts that feel intentional on desktop and mobile

component_roles.primary_action: strong clear CTA with high contrast
component_roles.secondary_action: support action visibly clickable but subordinate
component_roles.selectable_chip: interactive toggle/filter with clear selected state
component_roles.passive_tag: metadata/status label that does not look clickable
